selection.description: Applications received by 15 March are assessed on exam results, work experience, relevant courses and other documented qualifications. Applicants may also be asked for an interview or a short video. Absalon says the assessment criteria "have not yet been finalised".

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a diplomingeniør programme at a university college, which is a professionsbachelor programme: Absalon offers it as a diplomingeniør programme, the same professionsbachelor type as its Biotechnology BEng. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: Physics at B level or Geoscience at A level

officialRequirementsText.text: With passed: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level and Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level and English equivalent to Danish B-level.

notes: New programme, approved by the Ministry, with its first intake in September 2027.
Duration is taken from the seven-semester structure on Absalon's programme page.
